clips.title: The story
paras: In the Deadmines cove, Captain Greenskin readies a warship for Edwin VanCleef. The goblin pirate oversees its crew and construction for the Defias Brotherhood, preparing the ironclad juggernaut to sail against Stormwind.

Captain Greenskin paces the main deck of the juggernaut under construction in the Deadmines cove. A seasoned goblin mariner, he was brought into Edwin VanCleef's inner circle to turn an underground cavern into a drydock for a warship.

Captain Greenskin commands cutthroats, not stonemasons or bandits. His crew includes Mr. Smite, his fearsome tauren first mate, and Cookie, the murloc ship's cook. Together, they hold the gangplanks and upper deck, guarding the way to VanCleef's private cabin atop the bridge.
